note: A paper becomes a testable property before any course exists (register row DK1751, docs/institutions/lens-learning-loop.md stage 1). Each intake is hashed with its pre-registered plan; a course card links to its intake by id and sha256. Courses written before this rule have no intake and are published only with a stated reason.

intakes.claim: An agent that turns the failures it sees into a small suite of code graders, and checks the suite against labels it never sees, keeps a skill that finds faulty answers on cases it has not seen.
intakes.falsifier: The cohort that took the course catches no more faulty answers on held-out cases than the control, or the gain is gone by day 30, or the suite fails good answers more often than it did before.
intakes.measure: The course engine's held-out score (the least of catch rate, one minus twice the false-fail rate, and kappa, in permille) of the suite the agent holds, on audit seeds the course never used.
